decisions.decision: Board endorsed the ANR plan for 155 Reservoir Road after departmental review raised no issues (no motion recorded).
decisions.quote: plan was sent out for departmental review prior to the board's meeting with no issues being raised. board endorsed plan.

decisions.decision: The 404 West Townsend Road ANR mylar will be reprinted with the frontage on Lot 1 labeled and then endorsed by the Board.
decisions.quote: board member noted frontage on lot 1 was not labeled. mylar will be reprinted with the frontage and endorsed by the board.

decisions.decision: A Public Information Meeting for the Unitil site plan application is to be scheduled for December 14, 2015.
decisions.quote: a public information meeting will be scheduled for december 14, 2015.

decisions.decision: The Off-Street Parking Design Standards bylaw will be a warrant article for the May 2016 Annual Town Meeting.
decisions.quote: bylaw will be a warrant article for may 2016 annual town meeting.

decisions.decision: Board members are to contact A. Burney with proposals for the District Local Technical Assistance (Community Compact) application.
decisions.quote: board members to contact a. burney with proposals.

decisions.decision: A. Burney will check the status of the Summer Street project with the DPW Director, at K. Chenis's request for a bicycle lane.
decisions.quote: a. burney will check status with the dpw director.

decisions.decision: Board members suggested the Historical Commission and Open Space Committee be approached for input whenever scenic road hearings are held.
decisions.quote: d. prokowiew opined that the historical commission and open space committee should be approached for input whenever scenic road hearings are held.
